'''Little Mon Cal''', previously known as '''Jotsen's Island''', was the second-biggest land of mass in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] and, from c. [[517 BBY]] onward, a sovereign state inhabited mostly by aliens. From its capital city of [[Farsands]], it was also the seat of the main HQ of the [[Sailor's Union]].

==History==
The 10,000-kilometer-long continent later known as Jotsen's Island was the second biggest land of mass on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], after the simply-called northern continent.<ref name="BL" />

Around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], [[Hugo Bartyn]], an scout from [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]], became the [[Administrator (ORO)|Administrator]] of Lamaredd in the name of ORO. He built a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] in the northern continent and later a nearby city, [[Bartyn's Landing]], that he populated with Shanghaied [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from [[Chagri/Legends|Chagri]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Bartyn surreptitiously obtained the deeds to several key locations of Lamaredd previously owned by ORO, with Jotsen's Island being one of these.<ref name="BL" />

C. [[517 BBY]], a [[Sailor's Union]] was created and Bartyn was forced to cede Jotsen's Island to the aliens, who would use it as their homeland. At this point, the island was re-named Little Mon Cal, and the Sailor's Union moved their main headquarters there. The city of [[Farsands]] became the capital of the sovereign state of Little Mon Cal.<ref name="BL" />

Five centuries later, Little Mon Cal was a community of several aliens, nonetheless more backwater than the de facto "big city", Bartyn's Landing. The Landing's [[Bartyn's Landing town council|town hall]] dealt with Little Mon Cal about the trade of foodstuff and textiles.<ref name="BL" /> Emigrants from Little Mon Cal sometimes went to Bartyn's Landing.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref> By then, the Sailor's Union was still a powerful entity, with the local offices being controlled by shipping manager [[Kurline (Quarren)|Kurline]]. Several non-affiliated workers complained that the Union was threatening them.<ref name="BL" />

C. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], Little Mon Cal suffered the outbreak of a fungal plague. Bartyn's Landing sent a team, including their only doctor [[MD-0C6]], to deliver medicines. En route, they had a brush with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] wanting to steal the cargo and ask for a ransom.<ref name="BL" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the bad ending of the adventure ''[[Reckonings]]'', the [[Menahuun]] openly attack Bartyn's Landing and a war is unleashed. A number of civilians, including [[Miss Mylla]], attempt to leave Bartyn's Landing and start anew in a different part of Lamaredd; Mylla herself sets off for Little Mon Cal, but her boat crashes in [[the Rank]].
